name: Bungle in the Jungle
summary: Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan has studied the silithid and likens them to bees, with the queen as the weak point. A lure must draw her out, and it calls for a scent gland and soil from Un'Goro Crater, to the west.

sections.title: A Lure for the Queen
sections.body: Pestlezugg's research compares the silithid to bees. Destroy the hive's queen, and the rest should be thrown into disarray. A lure will be brewed to bring the queen out, and once she is summoned, you are the one to take her down.

sections.title: Reagents from Un'Goro
sections.body: Before the lure can be brewed, Pestlezugg needs reagents. The silithid hive lies west in Un'Goro Crater, and a scent gland must come from one of the bugs there. The gland cannot be damaged. Pestlezugg also needs five samples of the native Un'Goro soil.

faq.q: Who asks for the scent gland and soil, and where?
aliases: who gives bungle in the jungle

faq.q: What does Pestlezugg need for the lure?
faq.answer: One undamaged Gorishi scent gland, taken from one of the silithid bugs, and five samples of the native Un'Goro soil.

aliases: where to find gorishi scent gland
faq.answer: In Un'Goro Crater, to the west of Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Why does Pestlezugg want to bring out the hive queen?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg's research compares the silithid to bees, so with their queen gone the rest should fall into disarray.
